coverage_note: 00:26-06:10 is English meta-talk about the app (no Arabic from Medi). Medi's Arabic is Latin-transliterated up to ~36:48, then mostly Arabic script. Transcriber garbles several of Amal's Arabic lines (08:57 'سعود' = صوروا, 43:07/43:29 'سيفاء' = عاصفة, 44:24 'مضايقة' = المضارع, 36:44 'زد أن دنع'), and normalises some of Medi's script (44:47 بننزعج, 55:16 شبعان) so the slip she is fixing is not visible. Left out as S4: bibsatooni (08:26), 'bisbat' root-order (13:28), bansabit (54:52), joan/imbara/ams/feeya/إيه for هي, biniz'aj vowel (33:44), the 50:10-51:28 ع-stress run (Amal: 'don't stress on the عين'). Left out as self-fixes: 'Inti maz'ooj' → maz'ooja (25:27, she only echoed), anbisit→anbisti gender (18:51), باتعب→أتعب after لما (59:18). Note for the bucket file: Amal teaches إذا + بكون (keeps b-) at 53:49 while lamma + أكون was accepted at 55:39; buckets.md B3 says iza drops b-.

rows.medi_said: Did you enjoy, past tense, your time outside? Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee?
rows.amal_said: But what is it-- what is missing? It's not "انبسطتي." Something is missing. What is it? ... "في" or be?
rows.why: He wrote/said 'enbistee wa2tik' with no preposition; انبسط takes في/ب and she prompted until he found 'the fee' (06:50), then confirmed 'في or be'.
rows.english: Did you (f) enjoy your time outside?

rows.medi_said: I think I gotta take that off. Enbas... Oh, I put enbustee. I put enbustee.
rows.amal_said: the past... Yes, it is double T. ... You forgot the double T and the "في."
rows.why: Past 2fs of انبسط needs the -t- ending before -i (انبسطتي); he dropped it ('enbustee'), she spelled out انبسطت / انبسطوا and named 'double T'.

rows.medi_said: Have fun, plural, and take many pictures. So enbistoo oo saweroo
rows.amal_said: "سعود. سعود." (transcript garbled; she is saying صوروا)
rows.why: Plural command of صوّر is صوّروا; he said 'saweroo' then 'Sawroo' after her recast; her line is garbled in the transcript so the exact fix is inferred.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, enbasat, didn't I?
rows.amal_said: You put "انبسط". ... does the تخييم have emo-- تخيل have emotions? Does it get happy?
rows.why: Homework 'Camping made everyone happy': he used انبسط (get happy) for بسّط (make happy); she pointed out camping has no emotions and he switched to 'el takheem basat'.

rows.medi_said: kul hadha oo ams.
rows.amal_said: حم. بسط وحمس. ... Let's put the verbs together.
rows.why: He split the two verbs around the object ('basat kul hadha oo [7am]mas'); she recast with the verbs together first (بسط وحمس) then the object.

rows.medi_said: nafs?
rows.amal_said: كل حدا or what's everyone? ... الكل.
rows.why: Asked 'what's everyone?' he offered 'nafs' (wrong word); she supplied الكل (sheet: all / everyone | Elkul | الكل). She also accepted كل حدا.

rows.medi_said: Is it, isn't it lisa ma bansabit?
rows.amal_said: This is I don't get happy yet. What about don't get happy? It's a command. ... Command, so we keep the... ... ما تنبسط لسه.
rows.why: 'Don't get happy yet' is a negative command (ما + you-form تنبسط); he used the 1sg present ما بنبسط, then bare 'ma enbisit', and only reached 'ma teenbesit' after her prompts.

rows.medi_said: Ma teenbesit lisa ma ba'arif kul shey.
rows.amal_said: Ma, we don't know.
rows.why: The sentence was 'we don't know everything yet'; he said 1sg ما بعرف and she prompted 'we don't know', he fixed to 'ma ben a'arif'.

rows.medi_said: Is that the same? Andesit ishish?
rows.amal_said: انبسطت؟ ... إي.
rows.why: 'Enjoy something' needs the verb's preposition (انبسطت بـ/في إشي); he dropped it, she echoed with a question and he added 'be' himself.

rows.medi_said: Imbare lele or lele imbare.
rows.amal_said: ليلة امبارح.
rows.why: Didn't-know: she said 'I don't think we've ever used it' and built 'last night' with him; he first put the owner first (imbare lele), she gave ليلة امبارح and he restated 'lelet imbare'.

rows.medi_said: and anbisit, anbisit hafla- haflatik.
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. We forgot something. ... في ... حفلتك.
rows.why: Second time this lesson: انبسط needs في/ب before its object; he said 'anbisit haflatik' with no preposition, she said 'we forgot something' and he added 'fi'.

rows.medi_said: Okay. So ma'tanbisti halak.
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. I'm gonna keep making you repeat until you say في on your own. ... ما تنبسط بحالك. ... That's في or ب.
rows.why: Third missing في/ب after انبسط ('don't enjoy yourself'): she explicitly says she will keep making him repeat until he supplies في, then models ما تنبسط بحالك.

rows.medi_said: And I don't know how to say too much, right? ... Ziyadi?
rows.amal_said: You can say كتير. كتير or extra. كيف-- How do I say extra? ... زيادة.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he said he doesn't know 'too much' and guessed 'Ziyadi'; she gave كتير and accepted زيادة as 'extra' (sheet: extra / increase | Ziaadeh | زيادة).

rows.medi_said: so anbisti fi laylak.
rows.amal_said: This your night. One night. ... بليلتك. Yes. ليلتك.
rows.why: 'Your night' = one night ليلة + your → ليلتك (feminine -t- surfaces before the possessive ending, and -ik for her); he said 'laylak' (ليل + masc -ak), she prompted 'one night' and he fixed to laylatik.

rows.medi_said: so I, I think I remembered mazuj as annoying ... and moza- mozaj as annoyed.
rows.amal_said: بالعكس. ... If it has this oo sound. مزعوج، موجوع، محروج، مجروح. All of them is annoyed. Feeling the thing, not causing it.
rows.why: He swapped the two adjectives (مزعوج for 'annoying', مزعج for 'annoyed'); she said بالعكس and gave the oo-pattern rule. Sheet: annoyed | Maz3ooj | مزعوج; annoying | Muz3ej | مزعج.

rows.medi_said: Mutab? ... No.
rows.amal_said: Do you remember متعب؟ ... متعب ... is tiring. ... Same pattern as مزعج.
rows.why: Didn't-know on recall: asked if he remembers متعب he said 'No', she supplied 'tiring' and he then recognised it.

rows.medi_said: These voices or sounds are annoying. "hadhol el swat."
rows.amal_said: الأصوات.
rows.why: Plural of صوت is أصوات; he said 'swat' (initial a- missing) and she recast الأصوات; may be only a dropped vowel (S4), so low.

rows.medi_said: "Feeya za'ajat-za'ajatek."
rows.amal_said: أزعجتك. See? It's easier to say أزعجتك.
rows.why: She had asked for the أزعج (a-initial) form; he produced زعجتك, she recast أزعجتك and he said 'Oh, that's right, az'ajet'. Both forms exist, so low.

rows.medi_said: You guys annoy him. Why is that my favorite? Az'aj, az'ajtu.
rows.amal_said: أزعجتُ. ... You can't say أزعجتُ، wo. Doesn't sound right. ... Yes, there is an h.
rows.why: 'You (pl) annoyed him' needs the object ending on the verb (أزعجتوه); he stopped at أزعجتو and she said it does not sound right and that 'there is an h' at the end.

rows.medi_said: don't want to annoy them. Ana ma, ma bitti, az'ajkum.
rows.amal_said: أزعجهم. ... Nice.
rows.why: Object 'them' is -hum; he attached -kum (you pl); she recast أزعجهم. (b-drop after بدي was right.)
rows.english: I don't want to annoy them

rows.medi_said: So, don't annoy me. Ma ta'az-- Ma ta-- Ma ta'az'ajni. Ma ta'az'aj.
rows.amal_said: Which goes first؟ الـ ز أو الـ ع؟ ... Mm-hmm. ... ممتاز. ... ما تزعجني.
rows.why: Negative command of أزعج is ما تزعجني (no extra a- after the ت); he said 'ma ta'az'ajni' and she prompted on the letter order until he reached 'ma tiz'ajni'. Part of this may be a root-letter slip (S4).

rows.medi_said: ma ta'az'ajini. Ma ta'az'ajini.
rows.amal_said: ما تزعجيني. ... زد أن دنع. تزعجيني.
rows.why: Same form error in the feminine ('ma ta'az'ajini'); she recast ما تزعجيني twice until he said it in Arabic at 36:48.

rows.medi_said: So الولاد أزعجووو، أزعجووو،
rows.amal_said: أزعجوه؟
rows.why: 'Did the kids annoy him' needs -h on the verb (أزعجوه); he said أزعجوا with no object, she recast with the ending; he repeated أزعجو and she moved on.

rows.medi_said: هو بيزعج، بيزعجوني.
rows.amal_said: بيزعج، ... بيزعجني.
rows.why: 'He annoys me' is 3ms بيزعجني; he added the plural -u (بيزعجوني = they annoy me); she prompted 'بيزعج...' and he fixed.

rows.medi_said: Can I say-- Do I need to say like، هو بيزعج؟
rows.amal_said: بدون هو. بس the هي conjugation. بس without the هي.
rows.why: He asked whether 'It annoys me when...' needs a subject pronoun; she said use the he/she conjugation without هو. A question, not a produced error.

rows.medi_said: Okay, so بي-بيزعج-بيزعجوني.
rows.amal_said: بزعجني.
rows.why: Repeat of the same slip one minute later: plural -u on a 3ms verb; she recast and he said 'Why do I have the o in there?'.

rows.medi_said: هو منزعج بي... نز-نزعج؟ Or is it انزعج؟
rows.amal_said: Just like we did in إنزع. Yes. Just like we did with انبسط.
rows.why: Past of the get-annoyed verb: he offered the participle منزعج then bare نزعج before asking; she confirmed انزعج by analogy with انبسط.

rows.medi_said: انزعجتم. انزعج، انزعجنا.
rows.amal_said: طيب. Did you get annoyed of me؟
rows.why: 2pl past ending in her dialect is -tu (sheet: intu 8ashshaitu / intu 3meltu); he used MSA -tum and she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: Well, God. أنا نسيت الكلمة. أنا نسيت الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: سيفاء. (garbled = عاصفة)
rows.why: Didn't-know: he said he forgot the word for storm and she supplied it; he then produced عاصفة. Sheet: storm | 3aasefe | عاصفة.

rows.medi_said: إنت بتنزعج. إنتي بتنزعجي. إنتو بتنزعجو. هي-- هو بينزعج. هي بتنزعج. هما بينزعجو. إحنا بنن-بننزعج.
rows.amal_said: بننزعج. ... Been catching you saying the instead of the ب. ... ننزعج.
rows.why: She says she has been catching him using the wrong 'we' prefix ('the [m] instead of the ب'); the transcript normalises his form to بننزعج so the slip is not visible, only her rule.

rows.medi_said: ليش، ليش فرق من-- ليش فرق من WhatsApp? ... ليش فرق؟
rows.amal_said: كيف؟ ... No because I'm using لأنه عم بستعمل الـ telephone.
rows.why: He used the noun فرق (difference) for 'different' (ليش مختلف عن الواتساب); she said كيف؟ (did not understand), he explained in English and she answered without fixing. Sheet: different (from) | mu5talef | مختلف; other/different | 8air | غير.
rows.english: Why is it different from WhatsApp?

rows.medi_said: ليش فرق من WhatsApp?
rows.why: 'Different from' takes عن (مختلف عن), not من; let pass (she was replying on the phone).

rows.medi_said: Command tense. مااا، م-م-ما تنزع--
rows.amal_said: ما تنزعج. ما تنزعجي. احكيها كمان مرة.
rows.why: He stalled on the negative command 'don't get annoyed' and she finished it for him (then he drilled it).

rows.medi_said: ما تزعجي.
rows.amal_said: ما تنزعجي. Cuz it's ززز، all of the، all of them together. ... ما تنزعجي. خلص.
rows.why: 'Don't get annoyed' is the N-form ما تنزعجي; he kept dropping the ن (ما تزعجي = don't annoy), also at 48:08 and 48:15; she recast it repeatedly.

rows.medi_said: Don't get annoyed by me. So this is without the N.
rows.amal_said: ليش؟ ... ليش؟
rows.why: He claimed 'don't get annoyed by me' has no N (i.e. base verb); she asked ليش؟ and he corrected himself: 'It does have an N'.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, you're right. It's not-- It does have an N. ma-matan, matanzajini.
rows.amal_said: No. ... By me. ما تنزعجي. ... Yes. ما تنزعجي مني.
rows.why: 'Get annoyed BY me' uses انزعج + من + pronoun (ما تنزعجي مني); he hung the object on the verb (-ni); she said 'No' and modelled مني, he then said 'matanzaji minni'.

rows.medi_said: So ana... Ana, so I get annoyed. It's present tense. Anabazaj. Na ba-banj.
rows.amal_said: Gets.
rows.why: 'I get annoyed' is بنزعج (N-form); he said بزعج (I annoy); she prompted 'Gets.' and he fixed to 'anabanzaj'. Sheet: i get annoyed | Ana banze3ej | أنا بنزعج.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, anabanzaj, lama...
rows.amal_said: If.
rows.why: The sentence was 'if I'm hungry'; he started لما (when), she prompted 'If.' and he switched to إذا.

rows.medi_said: Oh, if. Iza. Iza akoon joan.
rows.amal_said: بس إذا بكون، مش أكون. ليش؟ ... If is conditional، but it doesn't take out the be. It keeps it.
rows.why: After إذا she wants بكون with the b- kept ('it doesn't take out the be'); he said أكون. Note: buckets.md B3 lists iza as a b-dropper but Amal's rule here is the opposite for بكون; filed under B8 (bakoon after lamma/iza).

rows.medi_said: لما أكون شبعان.
rows.amal_said: Full، مش hot. ... شبعان. كمان مرة.
rows.why: She heard the word for 'hot' (شوب) where 'full' (شبعان) was wanted and said 'Full, مش hot'; the transcript already shows شبعان so his actual slip is not visible; he then said شبعان and she accepted. Sheet: full (food) | Shab3aan | شبعان.

rows.medi_said: أنا بزعج ... مين
rows.amal_said: mean or what's the better one؟ The one who. يلي.
rows.why: 'I annoy WHO annoys me' needs the relative يلي/اللي, not the question word مين; she prompted 'the one who' and he switched to اللي.
rows.english: I annoy the one who annoys me

rows.medi_said: اللي who annoys me. Okay. So، اه، بينزعجني.
rows.amal_said: ليش أن annoys me. ... mm-hmm.
rows.why: 'Annoys me' is the base verb بيزعجني; he used the N-form بينزعجني (gets annoyed) with an object; she asked why and he fixed.

rows.medi_said: إيه بتنزع، بتنزعج لما I make retired.
rows.amal_said: mm-hmm. ... Her.
rows.why: English clause dropped into the Arabic sentence for 'I make her tired' while the verb is on her sheet (i tire / make people tired | Ana bata33eb | بتعِّب); he did produce أتعب 30 s later after her 'Her.' prompt, so this may just be a build stall.
rows.english: She gets annoyed when I make her tired

rows.medi_said: أتعب when I tire her. لما أتعبك. اه، أتعبها.
rows.amal_said: Her. ... ✓ Yes، أتعبها.
rows.why: Object 'her' is -ha; he first attached -ak (you) after she prompted 'Her.', then fixed to أتعبها himself and she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: annoyed. أنا انزعجت.
rows.amal_said: I didn't get.
rows.why: 'I wasn't annoyed' needs the negative ما before the verb; he said the affirmative, she prompted 'I didn't get' and he added ما.

rows.medi_said: اه، أنا، اه، زعلان. ... زعلان، زعلان.
rows.amal_said: زعلت. ... Here's your inter-internal flip. ... زعلت. ... أنا ما انزعجت، أنا زعلت.
rows.why: 'I was sad' in the past: he said أنا زعلان (present state, no كان) and held it twice; she recast the past verb زعلت to parallel ما انزعجت.

rows.medi_said: تعال. bye.
rows.amal_said: Bye.
rows.why: Replying to her سلام he said تعال (come!), which does not fit a goodbye; possibly a transcription of تمام. Let pass.
